# parser / csv-special-chars

**What it guards:** delimited-text (CSV) parsing of one data row with quoted fields containing commas and HTML; columns include a quoted header `special, field`.

**Source of input:** existing test resource `parser/csv_file_with_special_chars.csv` (one data row; the header line supplies the `columns` config). Mirrors the unit test `DelimitedTextExtractionRuleTest.processCsvFileWithSpecialCharacters (asserts inline; no *_parsed.json)`.

**Expected reviewed by:** _pending_ — generated by `-Dgolden.update=true` (no pre-existing `*_parsed.json`; the unit test asserts fields inline). Re-review when changing `config.json`.
